_about: Hand-written answer key for the demo: the rules a careful reader writes from lakeside_billing_manual.md. Two clauses are deliberately not rules: 5.2 (a respite-only daily cap, which no rule type expresses; the engine's daily maximum counts all services) and 6.3 (Lakeside Choice 'may be subject to additional review'). A good draft lists both as open questions.

source.quote: must be supported by a verified EVV visit for the member, service and date of service
a remaining 8 minutes or more counts as one further unit
Each claim must carry the Lakeside authorization number for the member and service
valid on the date of service
Claims that exceed the remaining balance are denied
Attendant care (S5125) must be billed with modifier U1
Claims must be received within 90 calendar days of the date of service
Lakeside rejects duplicate claims for the same member, service and date of service
